explanation.question_quote: The patient complains of recurrent chest pain in the ICU 56 hours post-angioplasty.
explanation.sentence: The patient develops recurrent chest pain 56 hours after angioplasty for a STEMI.
CK-MB typically returns to baseline within 48–72 hours, so a new rise after an initial decline helps identify reinfarction.
Troponin I can remain elevated for 7–10 days after the initial infarction, so a single elevated value at 56 hours does not distinguish the original infarct from a new one.
